name: ASTARTES
text: In each activation a friendly Angel of Death operative may take two Shoot actions or two Fight actions. Two Shoot actions need at least one bolt weapon, and repeating a bolt sniper rifle or heavy bolter costs the second one 1 extra AP. Every Angel of Death operative can counteract whatever its order.

name: CHAPTER TACTICS
text: When the team is chosen, pick a primary and a secondary Chapter Tactic from the eight below. Both apply to every Angel of Death operative; picking the same one twice adds nothing, so the builder asks for two different ones.

name: Dueller
text: When this operative fights or retaliates, each of your normal successes can block one unresolved crit, except against Brutal.

name: Resolute
text: Ignore every change to this operative APL, and Shock has no effect on it.

name: Stealthy
text: When this operative is shot and could retain cover saves, it retains one extra, or retains one cover save as a crit. Does not stack with the Vantage cover improvement.

name: Mobile
text: Fall Back costs 1 less AP, and the operative may Charge out of an enemy control range as long as the rest of the charge rules are met.

name: Hardy
text: When this operative is shot, defence results of 5 or more count as crits.

name: Sharpshooter
text: Shooting in an activation without Charge, Fall Back or Reposition, bolt weapons gain Accurate 1 and Severe.

name: Siege Specialist
text: Ranged weapons gain Saturate, and enemy operatives cannot assist against this operative when it fights or retaliates.

name: Iron Halo
text: Once per battle, ignore the damage of one attack die that would deal normal damage to this operative.

name: Grenadier
text: Can use frag and krak grenades with their Hit improved by 1 (to 3+). These uses are separate from any grenades the team picked as equipment.

name: Heroic Leader
text: Once per turning point choose one: use a firefight ploy that names this Captain for 0 CP (not Command Re-roll); use Combat Doctrine as you activate a friendly Angel of Death operative while the Captain is in the killzone and out of enemy control range (normal cost, once per turning point); or use Adjust Doctrine for 0 CP under the same conditions.

name: Doctrine Warfare
text: Once per battle each, while this operative is in the killzone, Combat Doctrine costs 0 CP when you pick the Assault doctrine, and separately 0 CP when you pick the Tactical doctrine.

name: Doctrine Warfare
text: Once per battle each, while this operative is in the killzone, Combat Doctrine costs 0 CP when you pick the Devastator doctrine, and separately 0 CP when you pick the Tactical doctrine.

name: Chapter Veteran
text: After operatives are selected, if this operative is on your roster, pick one extra Chapter Tactic for it for this battle. The pick may change from battle to battle.

name: Camo Cloak
text: Shooters ignore Saturate against this operative. It always has the Stealthy tactic; if your team also chose Stealthy it gets both of its options at once, one ordinary cover save and one as a crit.

name: OPTICS
text: Until the start of its next activation, enemies this operative shoots cannot be obscured.
